jobsnearme coordinator lesson (10-9): after merging ANY branch, even 'spec-only', run check:docs before pushing. A spec-only correction citing an id with no spec on main (FS-480) failed the deploy's Verify (run 38001104085). Also, `npm run -s check:docs | tail -1 && git commit` commits even when check:docs fails, because the pipe's exit status is tail's. Capture rc first.
